text:
maya: Customer acme-inc (acct 98431) reports noisy 'Billing rate anomaly' alerts firing ~50x in the last hour. Console charts show missing/irregular datapoints and several short spikes. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/abc123

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-423 by support

sam: looking into this. can you paste the alert expression and the chart query id?

maya: alert expression:
```
if sum(tokens_consumed{customer="acme-inc"}[5m]) > 100000
```
chart query (from UI): metrics.tokens.rate, rollup=60s, aggregation_window=5m, evaluation_interval=60s

liam: I see. We rolled a change yesterday that set rollup_offset to 0 (floor align) for rollups. Ingest writes at :30s, so a 5m aligned window evaluated at :00s can include a partial bucket -> apparent spike. Previously we aligned to ingestion boundary.

sam: steps to repro?

maya: repro steps customer provided:
1) generate a 90s token burst every ~4 minutes for an account
2) observe tokens.rate chart (rollup 60s) and alert condition above
3) alerts spike because some 5m windows capture burst fully, others capture only a 90s slice -> variance

liam: mitigation: set evaluation_interval to 30s or use a sliding window (avg_over_time) instead of sum_over_time. We'll push a hotfix to have console honor 'align=ingestion' and/or expose align param in alerting UI.

raja: does this line up with the backend deploy yesterday?

liam: yes deploy at 2026-01-15T02:14:00Z changed offset behavior. Rolling a revert/hotfix to canary now. ETA ~45m.

ops-bot: canary patch deployed (canary-1) - monitoring metrics for noisy alerts :eyes:

maya: told customer temporary workaround and they changed alert to `avg_over_time(tokens_consumed[5m]) > 20000` for now. they see fewer false fires. I'll update when hotfix is done :pray:

liam: logging follow-up ticket METRICS-788 to add explicit 'aggregation_align' parameter to alert UI and docs.

maya: thanks all, keeping this thread for timeline + notes. will close once customer ok and patch live.
